falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A decisive breakout above the August 2024 recovery high would invalidate the bottom pattern similarity, as the 2024 bottom formation required multiple weeks of consolidation below prior highs before sustained advance; this would signal V-shape recovery instead

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Compression to pre-correction complacency levels would falsify the bottom thesis, as the August 2024 bottom featured VIX remaining elevated (15-20) for weeks post-low; rapid normalization indicates no real capitulation occurred

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and DXY falls below 103.00 simultaneously
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination would signal a genuine risk-off flight to quality rather than the current stagflationary/rate-repricing dynamic; the 2024 bottom occurred with yields falling and dollar firming as recession fears dominated—this opposite regime would invalidate the pattern match

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
